description: Removes one phone number or email from a contact, as the contact card's Remove does; its texts, calls and emails leave the contact for the value's own thread and the contact's own phone/email moves to what remains. Refused for a value the booking platform writes back on its next sync (use the card's This is someone else for those). identifierId comes from read (entity client identifiers). An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat removes nothing more. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: remove_client_identifier
title: Remove a phone or email from a contact
